application_data_boundary: Application and demo data remain synthetic only; registered research data never becomes customer/account state.
global_prohibitions: No consumed evaluation split may be used for fitting, feature fitting, cross-validation, hyperparameter or threshold selection, representation selection, or model selection.
No CFPB narrative, annotation, structured metadata-derived target, or semantic label may be used for V2-C3 training or model selection.
No private, leaked, proprietary, scraped, or unverified bank support record may be used.
No taxonomy category alone may create a protected-write target; freeze_card and create_dispute require an explicit current action request.
